ValidationRule.description: Checks whether Total Tonnage Impacted is blank or not
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( $Setup.PMC_ProcessSwitches__c.PMC_BypassValidationRule__c),NOT(CONTAINS( $Profile.Name , 'Digital Hub' )), PMC_SS_RouteToQuality__c = True , OR(ISPICKVAL( Status , 'Closed'),ISPICKVAL( Status , 'Closure Pending')), ISBLANK( PMC_SS_TotalTonnageImpacted__c ))
